bug_report: The average calculation crashes when the input list is empty. I expected calculate_average([]) to return 0.0.
expected_root_cause: calculate_average divides sum(numbers) by len(numbers) without handling an empty list, so len() is 0 and a ZeroDivisionError is raised.

bug_report: When I call GET /users/999 for a user that does not exist, the API returns a 500 error. I expected a 404 response.
expected_root_cause: UserRepository.find_by_id returns None for a missing user, UserService.get_user passes it through, and get_user_profile reads user.id without checking for None. The AttributeError is caught by the broad except and turned into a 500.

bug_report: The last page of results is missing. With 5 items and 2 per page, page 3 should show the 5th item, but it is empty.
expected_root_cause: total_pages uses floor division (item_count // per_page), so a partial last page is not counted and paginate treats page 3 as beyond the end. It should round up.

bug_report: Discounts are not applied: a 10% discount on a 100.00 item still charges 100.00, and order totals ignore the discount.
expected_root_cause: apply_discount computes the discounted price into a local variable but returns the original price instead.

bug_report: Starting the service with PORT=abc silently listens on 8080. An invalid PORT should fail with a ConfigError so the misconfiguration is visible.
expected_root_cause: load_port wraps parsing in a broad except Exception that returns DEFAULT_PORT, which swallows the ValueError from int() and its own ConfigError for out-of-range ports. Only a missing PORT (KeyError) should fall back to the default.

bug_report: Orders from California are charged differently depending on whether the region is typed 'CA' or 'ca': 'CA' gets no sales tax and 'ca' gets the $10 default shipping instead of $5.
expected_root_cause: TAX_RATES has lower-case keys and SHIPPING upper-case keys, and both lookups are case-sensitive, so each lookup misses for one spelling of the region.

bug_report: A cache TTL of '90s' keeps entries for 90 minutes instead of 90 seconds.
expected_root_cause: UNITS in durations.py maps 's' to 60 instead of 1, so every seconds value, in the cache and in request timeouts, is read as minutes.

bug_report: Summarising an empty score list crashes with 'not enough values to unpack'. An empty input should give count 0, mean 0.0 and no best player.
expected_root_cause: parse_scores treats the empty string from ''.split(',') as an item and fails to unpack it; summarize then divides by zero and calls max() on an empty dict when there are no scores.

bug_report: February 2000 shows 28 days, but 2000 was a leap year.
expected_root_cause: is_leap_year returns year % 4 == 0 and year % 100 != 0, so years divisible by 400, such as 2000, are wrongly not leap years.

bug_report: Slugs drop accented letters: 'Café au lait' becomes 'caf-au-lait' instead of 'cafe-au-lait'.
expected_root_cause: slugify matches [a-z0-9]+ on the raw lower-cased title, which drops accented letters instead of transliterating them to ASCII.

bug_report: Splitting a $100.00 bill between 3 people charges $33.33 each, so the shares add up to $99.99 and a cent goes missing.
expected_root_cause: split_bill computes round(total_cents / people) once and returns that share for everyone, so whenever the total does not divide evenly the shares do not add up to the total.

bug_report: The updater says version 1.10.0 is not newer than 1.9.0, so users on 1.9.0 are never offered the update.
expected_root_cause: is_newer returns candidate > current on the raw strings, so '1.10.0' sorts before '1.9.0' because '1' < '9' character by character.

bug_report: The contact list shows Ada@x.com and ada@X.com as two different people. Addresses that differ only in case should appear once.
expected_root_cause: unique_emails uses dict.fromkeys(emails), which compares addresses case-sensitively, so case variants of the same address are kept as separate entries.
